title: Rarity Corrector
description: Ever hated some of the Rarity changes made in 1.21.2? well why not give you the option to change everything Back!
body:
# Description
Rarity Corrector is a datapack that aims to reverts all of the rarity changes made in [Minecraft Java Edition Version 1.21.2](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_1.21.2).

This pack reverts all of the [rarity changes](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_1.21.2#Gameplay_2) made in that version with one difference!

This pack is customizable in what is reverted and what isn't!\
if you want to do that then you may open the technical documentation for the pack.



# Technical Documentation
This section is for developers or server admins who would like to do these changes.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Disable all Command:
```
/function s_rc:cmd/disable_all
```

Enable all Command:
```
/function s_rc:cmd/enable_all
```
